dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: If experience is anything to go by, the further in we go, the tougher our enemies will get.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: But even if they don't, getting all the way to the end isn't exactly gonna be a walk in the park.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Whichever way you cut it, we have to make sure we're fully prepared.
